Market today: The GDP revision higher is a big deal, suggesting the economy is stronger than thought. This is the real driver for your tech/chip names, which are sensitive to economic outlook and interest rates.

Your holdings: CRWD (19.65%), QQQ (-11.3%), SMH (-33.62%), SMCI (-46.88%), SNOW (-20%), PLTU (-30.87%), MSFU (-16.66%), MU (-74.64%), SOXL (-85.75%), SPAL (-55.71%), QQQI (-15.53%), SPY (-2.41%), METU (-23.15%). Most are SELL/TRIM status and showing losses, especially the leveraged ETFs. SOXL and MU are deep in the red. Your leveraged ETFs are particularly vulnerable to drawdowns on margin.

Watch: The strength of the market rally and how it impacts your leveraged positions. Also, keep an eye on the semiconductor narrative.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your deeply underwater leveraged positions and the SELL signals on your core tech names.
plays: Consider trimming SMCI (-46.88%) or SNOW (-20%) if they show weakness; they are SELL status.
If QQQ (-11.3%) or SPY (-2.41%) break their stops, consider trimming to reduce margin risk.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
